sent_bad: Since you get paid on the 1st, you'll have cash sitting around for the whole month.
So rather than buying right after payday, hold off and buy near month-end when prices are likely at their lowest.
So pick the Monday closest to the end of the month.

"Don't put more into your investment than you are willing to lose, and keep in mind the rule of dollar-cost averaging" — so if you're unsure, you could spread purchases over time instead of making one big end-of-month buy.

**In short:** With your 1st-of-the-month payday, the document's suggested strategy is to wait until a Monday near the end of the month and buy early in the morning before the NYSE opens — while only investing what you can afford to lose and considering dollar-cost averaging if you're not confident in timing the market.
